name: Intercede
description: Forces anyone targeting the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell to save first or redirect elsewhere.

mechanics.text: While active, a creature that targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first succeed on a featureParams.saveAbility saving throw or choose a new target/lose the action instead. Distinct from feat.attacker-disadvantage (a flat penalty on the attack roll itself, not a save-or-redirect).
